supplied_facts.quote: Currently, the `AssertionError: Regex pattern did not match` thrown on exit of a `pytest.raises` context when an exception was raised but the provided pattern was not matched is attached to the exception actually raised as its `__context__` attribute implicitly.
This causes the test failure report to incorrectly claim that 'During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred'.
It should be attached to the `__cause__` attribute instead, such that the connective would be 'The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception', which is more correct.
